scope: Kinematic candidate; not a hardware specification or behavior acceptance gate
target_foot_spacing: Neutral F1 URDF collision-mesh centers; constant per-clip world lateral translation
target_foot_yaw: Neutral F1 foot direction relative to current pelvis heading; rotate about mesh center around world vertical
ground_strategy: One constant lift from the actual post-IK mesh minimum if below zero; never subtract source ground_z blindly

non_leg_velocity_filter.scope: Only source non-leg joints whose finite-difference speed exceeds their actual URDF limit; recheck delivered float32 values

notes: All tolerances, iteration limits and rendering settings are explicit software design settings. Foot spacing and correction amounts come from the actual F1 model/data.
